GROUND (a new Map Key section): the rock and sand recipes ask for, Granite, Basalt, Cinder Rock, Shell Limestone, Sandstone, Revelwood Stone, Blackmire Stone, Fine Sand, Sand, Veilwater Basin Sand, Cinder's Cradle Sand and Moss, shown as heat maps where they make up the ground, read from the game's own world.
Trees are heat maps now: each forest as thick as its trees grow, small groves too.
Forests and Ground are painted into a few images, so they no longer use up the map's drawing budget: more room for everything else.
Settings > Advanced > Region Names (on at first): each region's name as a faint watermark on the World Map, in the game's language.
The overworld map shows nothing in the Hollow Halls' corner of the world (the halls have their own map).
Chests lit through walls show as smooth outlines.
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y keep their history when you restart the game.
Fixed: the game could freeze opening a chest after using the Hollow Halls maps (they filled the game's texture memory). They now use images of their own.
Fixed: grey patches and white flashes on the Hollow Halls minimap.
Fixed: the World Map's hints (Mark Chest Looted...) showed on the Skills, Backpack and other tabs.
Dungeon Spoils (a new row under the chests): the Hollow Halls' end-room chests, Ranger, Mage and Warrior, filtered together. Hover one for its name and the Ectoplasm it takes to open.
Hollow Halls maps sit in a frame like the overworld map, with nothing of the world around or under them, and panning and zoom stay on the hall.
Fixed: the world map's north was drawn dark, without its sea: the game keeps the map's textures in 128 MB of graphics memory, too little for the whole map. The mod gives them 256 MB; PotatoPC=true in minimap_config.ini keeps the game's 128 MB.
Fixed: pressing 1 inside a Hollow Hall changed the overworld map's filters.
Fixed: back on the World tab with Q / E, a Hollow Hall's map was off in empty space until you pressed C.
Fixed: the minimap went blank near the edge of the world.
Fixed: a refilled chest's check mark showed in the Hollow Halls' corner of the overworld map.
